_comment: Diet engine quality baseline, re-recorded after Phases A-E (76-recipe library, 136-food catalogue). chosen_ingredient_share: the earlier 0.379 was measured while the recipe path was dead for any client who had chosen foods (a loop variable shadowed the similarity index; the planner failed open to templates), so it graded template-only plates. preference_satisfaction (D1) is the recall side: of the foods the chooser picked for a slot, the share that reached that slot's plate at least once in the week. Phase C made variety a week-level objective: a dish's sampling weight falls with its servings in the last seven days, and a dish already served WEEK_MAX_SERVINGS (2) times loses the judge to any fitting built plate. That cap is why distinct_dishes moved 81 -> 79 and dish_rate 0.839 -> 0.774: at a 1,133 kcal breakfast one dish reaches the target and was served six days of seven; those days are now built plates. Measured caps 3 and 4 give dish 0.792 / 0.815 with worst repeats 3 / 4. The gate asserts these as bounds in the direction of improvement.
